description: This file implements functions related to fixed-offset time zones, including parsing time zone names, converting offsets to names, and generating abbreviations. It is part of the internal cctz namespace within the Abseil time library.

methods.name: Format02d
methods.description: Formats an integer as a two-digit string.

methods.name: Parse02d
methods.description: Parses a two-digit string into an integer.

methods.name: FixedOffsetFromName
methods.description: Parses a fixed-offset time zone name into a seconds offset.

methods.name: FixedOffsetToName
methods.description: Converts a seconds offset into a fixed-offset time zone name.

methods.name: FixedOffsetToAbbr
methods.description: Generates an abbreviation for a given seconds offset.
